package.name: pika_nero_teleop
package.description: Teleoperation of an AgileX NERO carrying a Pika Gripper, driven by a handheld Pika Sense. Overlay on top of PikaAnyArm/agx_arm_ros: it exists because the upstream nero launch assumes the AgileX CAN gripper on the arm flange, while the Pika Gripper is a USB device on its own serial link.
